rubrics.justification: Description is detailed and broadly consistent with a 3AA day-5 blastocyst, including expanded cavity, compact ICM, cohesive TE, and thinning zona. Minor concern is some image-specific details (exact quadrant, excluded fragment, granularity) may be over-interpreted from a single static image.

Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, endometrium, first-cycle status, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis, with appropriate emphasis on maternal age/ploidy as the main modifier.

Reasoning is structured and internally consistent, and the probability estimate is explained stepwise. Minor issues include somewhat confident quantitative assumptions for euploidy/implantation and a few speculative modifiers.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: SET for a good-quality blastocyst, no bed rest, ERA not after one failure, nuanced PGT-A discussion. Small deviations include over-specific medication dosing and a few statements presented more definitively than guidelines support.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, follow-up, and contingency planning after failure or miscarriage, with useful nuance around SET, PGT-A, luteal support, and future cycle strategy.
